# scamp_broker (Resource)

Manages a message broker: NATS with JetStream, RabbitMQ or Kafka on its own server, run and updated by ServersCamp. The broker has its own name under the broker domain with a certificate we renew.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scamp_broker" "events" {
  name   = "events"
  engine = "nats"
  plan   = "nats-bs-s"
}

output "nats_url" {
  value     = "nats://${scamp_broker.events.user}:${scamp_broker.events.password}@${scamp_broker.events.hostname}:${scamp_broker.events.port}"
  sensitive = true
}
```

Plans are named by engine: `nats-`, `rmq-`, `kafka-`, then `bs` (Basic) or `hf` (High Frequency) and the size,
e.g. `kafka-hf-m`. A wrong name fails with the list of plans of the engine.

## Changes in place

- `plan`: another plan of the same engine. The server restarts.
- `disk_gb`: grows; it never shrinks. A new broker starts with its plan's disk and grows right after.
- `public`, `require_tls`.

Changing `name`, `engine`, `version`, `network_id` or `security_group_id` replaces the broker, with its messages.

## Schema

### Required

- `engine` (String) nats, rabbitmq or kafka. Changing it replaces the broker.
- `name` (String) Name of the broker: 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. It is the start of its address, NAME-xxxxxx. Changing it replaces the broker.
- `plan` (String) Plan, e.g. nats-bs-s. Changed in place to another plan of the same engine; the server restarts.

### Optional

- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk size in GB. A broker starts with the disk of its plan; a bigger value grows it in place after it is made. It never shrinks.
- `network_id` (String) UUID of the network, attached to a router. Without it the account's default network. Changing it replaces the broker.
- `public` (Boolean) Ports on the router's public address. Default false. Who may connect is the security group's to say. Changed in place.
- `require_tls` (Boolean) Every connection over TLS; off: TLS and plain both. Default false. Changed in place.
- `security_group_id` (String) UUID of a security group. Without it a new group is made with the engine's ports open and everything from the private network and VPN Gateway. Changing it replaces the broker.
- `version` (String) Engine version. Without it the engine's default. Changing it replaces the broker.

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) The broker's name, NAME-xxxxxx under the broker domain.
- `id` (String) The broker's id.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The admin user's password.
- `port` (Number) The engine's port.
- `private_ip` (String) The server's address in its network.
- `public_host` (String) Public address, empty when public is off.
- `public_port` (Number) Public port, empty when public is off.
- `state` (String) creating, configuring, running, updating, failed or deleting.
- `user` (String) The admin user.

## Import

```shell
terraform import scamp_broker.events 4e5b1e18-9802-4d1a-962b-d03a32f5b5d5
```
